get.description:
Get all ads or filter and order them using query parameters.

Filtering operators:
:   (equals)
!:  (not equals)
>   (greater than)
>=  (greater than or equal)
<   (less than)
<=  (less than or equal)
~   (contains, case-insensitive)

Examples:
/ads?filter=is_active:true
/ads?filter=program_id:1
/ads?filter=bid_price>=1000
/ads?order_by=bid_price&sort=desc
/ads?order_by=created_at&order_by=bid_price&sort=desc&sort=asc

parameters.description: Fields to order by. Can be repeated.
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.description: Sort direction for each order_by field (asc or desc). Can be repeated.
parameters.name: sort
